properties.NAME: WASCO (Ore.)
properties.CHANGE: WASCO (Ore.) created by Oregon Territory from CLACKAMAS (Ore.), JACKSON (Ore.), LANE (Ore.), LINN (Ore.), and MARION (Ore.); included territory in present Ore., Ida., Mont., and all that part of present Wyo. N of 42 degrees N lat and W of the Rocky Mtns.
properties.CITATION: Ore. Terr. Laws 1853, 5th sess., spec., pp. 26-27
